rules: Give the viewer a clear target and a gaze change before the strongest expression.
For this rig at 24 fps, begin by testing 8–16 frames of attention, a 6–12 frame pause, then a 12–24 frame expression onset. These are adjustable starting points, not universal timing.
Use separate gaze, face and gesture channels; same-channel intervals cannot overlap.
An expression persists after its interval. Add a later expression to return to neutral.
Inspect onset, maximum expression and the next beat. Change one timing or intensity parameter before rewriting the scene.
inspection: Playable preview plus contact sheet/action-boundary frames; human or vision review for appeal.
stop: Stop when requested effect is reviewed or workflow budget is exhausted.
